description: Search everything the index knows (APIs, MCP servers, A2A agents and the operations, tools and skills they expose) for what an agent needs to do. Use this first when you do not know which kind of thing you need. Supports field filters such as api:payment or op:refund method:POST.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10).

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (default 0).

protocol.description: Only entities that speak this protocol, e.g. rest, graphql, mcp or a2a. Optional; the protocol: filter in the query does the same.

query.description: What the agent needs to do, in plain words or with filters, e.g. "send an SMS" or "api:payment auth:oauth". Free words plus optional field filters. Words match names, descriptions and capability names (all words must match; falls back to any word). Filters: api:/mcp:/agent:<words> (scope to that kind and also match its operations/tools/skills), op:/endpoint:/tool:/skill:<words> (search inside operations, tools or skills), method:GET|POST|..., path:/v1/charges, group:<name>, domain:example.com, org:<slug or name>, auth:oauth|api_key|bearer|none, protocol:rest|graphql|mcp|a2a, verification:declared|observed|protocol_verified, verified:true, lang:fr, tag:<tag>. Prefix a word or filter with - to exclude it; use "quotes" for a phrase. Examples: `payment`, `api:payment auth:oauth`, `op:refund method:POST`, `mcp:calendar -auth:none`, `tool:search domain:github.com`. Searching all kinds.

name: search_capabilities
